data.description:
## Context / Problem
Closing recovery ticket `irascible-clueless-basenji` after `set-file-impact --none` spent approximately five minutes in the deterministic work-landed precheck before succeeding. The ticket had `file_impact=[]` / `file_impact_scope=none`, no descendants, a signed PASS plan review, and a signed PASS completion verification. No commit was required or expected.

The hot path is unconditional in `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py`:
- `_check_work_landed` calls `_referencing_commits(...)` before checking `field_reads.file_impact(...)` (current lines 219-220).
- `_referencing_commits` reads the full `git log`, extracts every historical ticket reference, and calls `resolve_ticket_id(..., quiet=True)` for every unique reference (current lines 326-345).
- During the reproduction, interruption showed the process inside `resolve_ticket_id -> _scan_alias -> json.load`, scanning tracker snapshots for an unrelated historical reference.

This work is unnecessary when neither the ticket nor any accepted descendant declares file impact: `_check_file_impact_vs_diff` already treats an empty union as out of scope. The current ordering turns an ordinary no-code close into a repository-history × ticket-resolution scan.

## Proposed Plan
- Add a cheap guard in `_check_work_landed` based on the union of file impact for the ticket and accepted descendants.
- Return before `_referencing_commits` when that union is empty.
- Preserve existing commit-presence and declared-impact-vs-diff enforcement when any in-scope file impact exists.
- Add focused regression tests proving the no-impact path never invokes commit discovery and the impact-present path remains enforced.
- Confirm the change does not alter administrative disposition, force, descendant-credit, or completion-verifier semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Closing a ticket whose accepted ticket/descendant scope has no file impact does not call `_referencing_commits`.
- [ ] A ticket or accepted descendant with file impact still runs referencing-commit discovery and existing landing checks.
- [ ] Existing file-impact-vs-diff and descendant-credit tests remain green.
- [ ] A regression test fails if full-history commit discovery is reintroduced on the empty-impact path.
- [ ] The implementation preserves completion-verifier and administrative-disposition behavior.
data.title: Close precheck scans all commit references when file impact is empty
